plugins.name: outputty
plugins.description: Spec-driven Claude Code plugin. Audit a repo for the work worth doing, grill business + technical goals as distinct passes, plan into a dependency-ordered task graph, then build it hands-off: the session ships one stacked PR per layer, and one read-only master QA reviews the whole stack at the end. Product memory is six queried record sets in .claude/ (product.yaml for North Star + Language, plus roadmap.yaml, architecture.yaml, tasks.yaml, lessons.yaml, examples.yaml), answered by skills/outputty/docs.js, which requires the bun runtime. Every decision lives in those records and nowhere else; the laziest-working-diff build discipline is owned in-plugin.
